name: 79902 · El Paso, TX
findings: ZIP 79902 (El Paso) has 136 nonprofit organizations. 73 of them (54%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 52 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 79902 (El Paso) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 79902 (El Paso) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 52 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.
